race.title: Matchbook Betting Exchange Rated Novice Chase
race.verdict: RATTLEDELATCH opened his chasing account in good style at Tramore last time and can add to it here at the likely chief expense of fencing newcomers Torpille Dagrostis and Good Option who are both in very good hands and bring potential. Butter Fingers completes the shortlist now back at a more suitable trip. RATTLEDELATCH (IRE) TORPILLE DAGROSTIS (FR) GOOD OPTION (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Rattledelatch (5/2), Torpille Dagrostis (3/1), Ifallgoeswell (4/1), Trasna Na Pairce (6/1), Good Option (7/1), Butter Fingers (8/1), Dollar Nolimit (14/1), Tatateo (16/1)
